text.tspan: Marking a parcel DELIVERED — proof is uploaded first
Proof first — if the upload fails
nothing has changed and the courier retries
on failure it falls back to a placeholder address
fetches a privacy-safe snapshot from parcel-service,
writes the projection, then pushes over STOMP and SSE
merchant-service signs the payload with HMAC
and POSTs it to the merchant's endpoint

svg.text: store object in MinIO, insert delivery_proofs row
authorise — assigned courier or dispatcher only
belonging to this parcel, and FAILED requires a reason
Thymeleaf template, PII masked in the log
Flow 3 — Courier status update triggers notifications
